Electronic housings, handheld device parts, drone components and protective covers

01 GET TO KNOW

Unset PC ABS

Unset PC ABS is made from recycled high-quality PC ABS material left over during production, giving it a second life instead of creating unnecessary waste. Each batch comes in a random color, but the printing quality stays the same as regular PC ABS. 
With heat resistance up to 122°C, high impact resistance and strong layer bonding, it is ideal for functional prototypes, automotive components, housings and technical parts where exact color is not important.

Note: For best results, we recommend using an enclosure or enclosed 3D printer.

02 HELPFUL REMINDERS

Tips & tricks

1. Use a warm enclosed printer

A 60-70 °C chamber helps reduce warping in PC ABS.

2. Ventilate the print area

Engineering materials need good room ventilation or extraction.

3. Dry thoroughly before printing

Dry at 80 °C for 4-6 h and print soon after drying.

4. Use an adhesion/release layer

High bed temperatures can bond too strongly to some surfaces.

5. Let parts cool gradually

Slow cooling reduces stress and cracking.

6. Recommended print speed

Use ≤ 250 mm/s for normal prints; Max Printing Speed is the tested ceiling.

01 GET TO KNOW

Refill PETG Hyper Speed Pastel

Refill PETG Hyper Speed Pastel combines the strong and durable properties of PETG HS with a soft pastel color palette. Its gentle shades give prints a clean, modern, and elegant look, making it ideal for decorative pieces, figurines, electronic gadgets, and creative everyday projects.

The refill format helps reduce plastic waste while keeping the same high-quality printing performance. Designed for fast, reliable 3D printing, it maintains strong layer adhesion, durability, and smooth surface quality, even at speeds up to 1000mm/s.

02 HELPFUL REMINDERS

Tips & tricks

1. Dry before high-speed printing

Dry at 55 °C for 4-6 h; wet PETG strings and weakens surfaces.

2. Store and print dry when possible

PETG absorbs moisture quickly after opening.

3. Use a release layer on sticky beds

Glue stick can protect PEI/glass from PETG over-bonding.

4. Keep walls quality-focused

Let infill run faster while visible walls stay moderate for cleaner surfaces.

5. Pastel, Skin, and Neon use this data

These variants are grouped under PETG Hyper Speed.

6. Recommended print speed

Use ≤ 300 mm/s for normal prints; Max Printing Speed is the tested ceiling.

01 GET TO KNOW

Refill PETG Hyper Speed Transparent

Refill PETG Hyper Speed Transparent combines the strong and durable properties of PETG HS with a clear, see-through effect. Its transparent finish lets light pass through the print, making parts look clean, modern, and visually lighter.

The refill format helps reduce plastic waste while keeping the same high-quality printing performance. Designed for fast, reliable 3D printing, it maintains strong layer adhesion, durability, and smooth surface quality, even at speeds up to 1000mm/s.

02 HELPFUL REMINDERS

Tips & tricks

1. Dry extremely well

Dry at 55 °C for 6-8 h; moisture makes transparent PETG cloudy and stringy.

2. Use slow clarity speeds

Use 15-20 mm/s when transparency is more important than speed.

3. Use thicker walls for clearer parts

More solid material paths scatter less light than sparse thin shells.

4. Keep cooling low for clarity

Lower cooling can improve layer bonding and optical clarity.

5. Use a release layer on sticky beds

Glue stick can protect PEI/glass from PETG over-bonding.

6. Use higher flow for maximum transparency

For clearer transparent PETG, use slightly higher flow and 5 °C more nozzle temperature than PETG Hyper Speed; do not jump higher unless testing confirms it.

01 GET TO KNOW

Refill PLA Transparent

Refill PLA Transparent combines easy PLA printing, a translucent color effect and less plastic waste. Its refill format reduces disposable spool waste while keeping the same reliable, beginner-friendly printing experience.

The material lets light pass through the print, giving models a clean and visually lighter look. Ideal for lamps, vases, ornaments, display pieces and decorative projects.

02 HELPFUL REMINDERS

Tips & tricks

1. Dry extremely well

Dry at 45 °C for 6-8 h; moisture makes transparent prints cloudy.

2. Use slow clarity speeds

Use 15-20 mm/s when transparency is more important than speed.

3. Use thicker walls for clearer parts

More continuous material paths scatter less light than sparse thin shells.

4. Reduce cooling for clarity

Lower cooling can improve layer fusion and optical clarity.

5. Avoid heated chambers

Avoid extra chamber heat if heat creep appears.

6. Use higher flow for maximum transparency

For clearer transparent PLA, use slightly higher flow and 5 °C more nozzle temperature than PLA Original; do not jump higher unless testing confirms it.

01 GET TO KNOW

PLA Pearl

PLA Pearl combines easy PLA printing with a soft pearly shine for elegant, refined 3D prints. Its special blend of subtle glitter particles creates a gentle shimmer without the strong sparkle of classic glitter filaments.

Easy to print and beginner-friendly, PLA Pearl delivers reliable results and is ideal for jewellery-style accessories, gifts, figurines, home decor, display pieces and creative projects where a more premium finish matters.

02 HELPFUL REMINDERS

Tips & tricks

1. Dry thoroughly before printing

Dry at 45 °C for 4 h, then store sealed or print from dry storage.

2. Keep PLA out of hot chambers

Use an open printer or avoid extra chamber heat; heated chambers can cause heat creep.

3. Clean build surface before fast prints

Finger oils can lift corners once speeds rise; clean PEI/glass before important parts.

4. Use practical first-layer speed

Start first layers around 60 mm/s, then increase speed after adhesion is stable.

5. Use normal room ventilation

Ventilate long prints and print rooms even with low-odor PLA.

Use ≤ 300 mm/s for normal prints; Max Printing Speed is the tested ceiling.

01 GET TO KNOW

PLA Silk Tri Color

PLA Silk Tri Color combines the easy printability of PLA with a refined, silk-like glossy finish. Using advanced co-extrusion technology, three colors are blended into a single filament strand, creating smooth color transitions and a unique tri-color effect.

The final look shifts depending on the model shape, light direction and viewing angle, making every print more dynamic, colorful and eye-catching.

02 HELPFUL REMINDERS

Tips & tricks

1. Set wall speed for color blending

For better color blending, set inner and outer wall speed to 100 mm/s.

2. Orient the model intentionally

Part orientation changes which colors face the viewer.

3. Print a test cylinder first

Print a test cylinder to see the multicolor distribution before the real print, then rotate the object in the slicer to place color shifts intentionally.

Dry at 45 °C for 4 h and store sealed.

Use lower visible-wall speed when shine matters more than blend uniformity.
